type: tooling: the ninth standing rule turned into code and validated
conclusion: the preflight audit reproduces all five historical failures and passes the clean design

bonus_finding.what: 6.2 percent of evaluation rows in the both-unseen condition carry a library pathway code never seen in training
bonus_finding.direction: the pathway arm is mildly handicapped exactly where it is supposed to help, so the substitution effect is a slight underestimate

what_it_is: a necessary preflight check, seconds to run, three levels: feature dispersion and unseen codes, split overlap, prediction dispersion
what_it_is_not: sufficient; passing removes one failure mode, it does not validate a design

scope_declaration.note: the new file is under research/tools/, not src/ or the root tools/
